method: A live fullscreen game session was switched through the in-game language menu to Русский VN. The prepared save was loaded once through the normal menu, then its QuickSave snapshot was loaded with F7 for the gameplay captures. macOS captured each stable screen at native resolution; the locale label was added afterward without resizing the source frame.

screenshots.review: Localized high-resolution title buttons are centered, legible, and not clipped.
Russian labels render without missing glyphs; the repaired НАЗАД button is visible below the farm selector.
Gus's portrait, localized name Гас, and multi-line Russian dialogue render without clipping or missing glyphs.
The axe name, category, and wrapped item description render legibly together with the localized inventory metadata.
The expanded Знакомства journal entry, body copy, and 3/28 progress line render within the quest panel.

smapiLog.note: The log records the exact custom locale, all three locale-specific asset loads, the repaired native back-label overlay, the QuickSave F7 load, and no Content Patcher ERROR or WARN entries. SMAPI emits its expected changed-save-serializer warning for QuickSave.
